versions.changelog: Fixed missing outpath variable in IQ mode; horizontal colorbar below waterfall; spectrum and waterfall perfectly aligned via fig.add_axes with identical left/right margins; DC spike visible (clips to red); noise floor computed from non-DC data

Horizontal colorbar below waterfall; spectrum and waterfall perfectly aligned via explicit fig.add_axes positioning; same x-extent for both plots; DC spike visible (saturated red); noise floor computed from non-DC data

DC spike visible in waterfall (clips to red/saturated, not nulled); noise floor computed from non-DC data so color scale stays correct; spectrum shows full DC spike; same X-axis for spectrum and waterfall

IQ mode: FFT averaging (50x default) for noise reduction; DC spike nulled and marked; color scale anchored to noise floor (vmin=noise, vmax=noise+20dB) for blue background; spectrum Y-axis clipped to avoid DC dominance; same X-axis range for spectrum and waterfall; LNA default 16; --avg flag for FFT averaging control

IQ mode: high-resolution waterfall via hackrf_transfer + FFT spectrogram (~5 kHz res, no artifacts); sweep mode preserved as quick preview; auto-selects sample rate based on bandwidth; auto-cleanup of temp IQ files; fixed color scale (noise=blue, signals=yellow/red); signal SNR reporting

Fixed waterfall parser for correct sub-bin handling; per-sweep median normalization; noise-floor-anchored color scale (blue bg, yellow signals); default gains LNA=20 VGA=20; --no-normalize flag; signal SNR reporting; dark theme

Fixed waterfall parser for correct sub-bin handling; per-sweep median normalization; noise-floor-anchored color scale (blue bg, yellow signals); default gains LNA=20 VGA=20; --no-normalize flag; signal SNR reporting; dark theme
Initial release: frequency scanning, IQ capture, signal analysis, waterfall visualization, and FM/AM/SSB demodulation for HackRF One
